questions.question: The equation C = 1.5m + 4 gives the cost C, in dollars, of a taxi ride of m miles. What is the best interpretation of 1.5 in this context?

The fixed starting fee, in dollars
The number of miles the taxi travels per dollar

questions.skill: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error
questions.question: A random sample of 400 residents of a city was surveyed, and 62% of those surveyed said they support building a new park. The margin of error for this estimate is 4 percentage points. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
options: Exactly 62% of all residents of the city support building the park.
Between 58% and 66% of the 400 residents surveyed support building the park.
It is plausible that between 58% and 66% of all residents of the city support building the park.
At least 66% of all residents of the city support building the park.
questions.correct: It is plausible that between 58% and 66% of all residents of the city support building the park.
